query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_assessments,
  ROUND(AVG(confidence_score), 1) as avg_confidence,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confidence_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as low_confidence_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fraud_risk_level IN ('high','critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_fraud_risk,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fraud_risk_level = 'medium' OR fraud_risk_level = 'elevated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as medium_fraud_risk,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fraud_risk_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_fraud_assessment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enriched_photos_json IS NOT NULL AND enriched_photos_json != '[]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_enriched_photos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN damage_photos_json IS NOT NULL AND damage_photos_json != '[]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_damage_photos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ai_repair_estimate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_repair_estimate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN total_loss_indicated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_loss_count,
  ROUND(AVG(processing_time), 0) as avg_processing_ms
FROM ai_assessments;
